# Code of Conduct

The full text lives in the docs: [Code of Conduct](https://vernllm.dev/docs/code-of-conduct) (or [apps/docs/content/docs/code-of-conduct.mdx](https://github.com/LakBud/vernLLM/blob/main/apps/docs/content/docs/code-of-conduct.mdx) if browsing the repo).

Summary: be respectful, assume good faith, and don't harass or discriminate against other contributors or users. Violations may be enforced by maintainers, including removal of content or bans from project spaces.

Report violations privately to a maintainer via GitHub.
